Title: Aura TV: Smart TV Launcher
Short Description: Clean, fast, and customizable launcher for Android TV and Google TV.
Full Description:
Transform your Android TV experience with Aura TV, a clean, lightning-fast, and fully customizable TV launcher. Designed specifically for smart TVs, TV boxes, and streaming devices, Aura TV puts you in complete control of your home screen.

✨ KEY FEATURES

• Smart App Organization
Categorize your apps into dynamic folders such as Streaming, TV Apps, Games, Work, and Sideloaded. Keep your home screen tidy and intuitive.

• Sideloaded App Support
Easily access and launch all sideloaded mobile apps alongside native Android TV applications without needing extra tools.

• OLED Burn-In Protection
Built-in ambient screensaver with configurable inactivity timers protects your OLED and AMOLED TV displays against screen burn-in.

• Custom Banners & Icons (Banner Fixer)
Replace low-resolution or missing TV banners with custom 16:9 high-resolution images or URLs to keep your grid looking crisp and beautiful.

• Remote Number Hotkeys (0–9)
Assign your favorite apps to remote number keys (0-9) to launch them instantly from anywhere on the home screen.

• App Visibility & Stealth Vault
Hide system apps you rarely use or protect private applications with a stealth unlock passcode.

• Personalized Themes & Wallpapers
Choose from elegant Obsidian gradients, minimal pure OLED black themes, or your own custom wallpapers, complete with dynamic glow palettes.

• Remote-First D-Pad Navigation
Smooth, responsive, and natural navigation tailored specifically for D-Pad remote controls.

• Fast App Management
Deep-stop background memory-consuming apps, view detailed app storage usage, sort apps alphabetically or by recent usage, and backup/restore your configuration.

🔒 PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS
Aura TV values your privacy. App scanning (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES) is strictly used locally to detect installed TV and sideloaded apps. No personal data, telemetry, or app usage lists are ever collected, stored, or transmitted.

Upgrade your TV home screen today with Aura TV!
